text: Garcia-Molina and Salem's compensating transaction does not erase the step it compensates (Sagas, section 1: it "undoes, from a semantic point of view," what its step did, without returning the database to the state before it); it is a new step with the opposite business effect, so a voided hold leaves a hold and a void on the driver's statement.
